capabilities: List newest files added to the vault in a sidebar view
Track first-seen timestamps via a plugin-managed index
Filter by file extension and exclude path prefixes
Configure sort source, timestamps, and list length
Open files with native workspace behavior
extras: Large parts of the README describe developer workflows (a Windows test-vault sync command, CDP smoke testing, release checklist) rather than user-facing features.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that shows files by when they were first added to the vault, and the file explorer does not surface attachments and Markdown files together by recency of addition.
summary: Sidebar view that lists the newest files added to the vault, including never-opened attachments and non-Markdown files.
